title: Shoots Currency
description: This Data/Resource Pack makes it where you can convert Minerals (Netherite, Diamonds, Gold, Lapis) into a currency named "Shoots"
body:
This Data/Resource Pack makes it where you can convert Minerals (Netherite, Diamonds, Gold, Lapis) into a currency named "Shoots".

When having minerals in your inventory do /function shoots:conversion/start to convert them into Shoots.
